transcript.text: d/w not cleaning pls help, gritty bits left on glasses n bowls, beko

Before you start, switch it off and unplug it. From what you have described, the most likely cause is drain filter (clean first - gritty/sandy residue). Take out the lower rack, twist and lift out the filter in the bottom of the tub, and rinse it under a tap — a clogged filter starves the spray arms of water. Was the filter dirty or clogged (and is it clean now), or was it already clean?
[Helpful to see: image "Where the filter is" — The filter sits in the base of the dishwasher, usually under the bottom spray arm. Twist it out anticlockwise and rinse it under a tap. Typical layout — your dishwasher may differ.]
ok did the filter, it was full of food n grease. its clean now
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
